decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks that met different use cases: high-capacity tactical (QT&QY, Seibertron), insulated (TOURIT), compact sling (NICGID), and waterproof (Piscifun). I narrowed my selection to the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack because it offers the best value. With over 6,000 reviews and a 4.7 rating, it is highly social-proofed. Compared to the Seibertron Falcon which is smaller (37L) and more expensive ($59.99), the QT&QY provides more capacity for a lower price ($39.99) while maintaining excellent user feedback regarding its durability and pocket organization.
